summary_1line: Rama entrusts Hanuman with a ring as a token for Sita, affirming confidence that Hanuman will successfully find her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama places his inscribed ring into Hanuman’s hands as the monkey hero bows before him.
Sugriva praises Hanuman’s unmatched speed and strength while the gathered monkeys look on in the forest.
Hanuman stands resolute before Rama and Sugriva, holding the ring that will prove his message to Sita.
